Well, I can think of at least one exception to your statement about tv series's not lasting. Smallville. That show went for ELEVEN SEASONS. I think that's probably one of the longest series I have ever heard of, period. Another exception might be Once Upon a Time, but, as you said, that show is only in it's early stages yet. Still, it has already spawned a splitoff, Once Upon a Time in Wonderland, which is also proving to be immensely popular. In short, I believe that with the right director, actors, and backing, it would make an absolutely brilliant series. I would definitely watch it.
